title: Precise Sign Co. and La Crosse Sign Group Earn Top Honors in Daktronics Sign Design Contest
summary: Sign company professionals attending Sales Expo 2026 recognized innovative digital signage projects for education and entertainment customers.

# Precise Sign Co. and La Crosse Sign Group Earn Top Honors in Daktronics Sign Design Contest


### Sign company professionals attending Sales Expo 2026 recognized innovative digital signage projects for education and entertainment customers.


[Daktronics](https://www.daktronics.com/en-us) (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, recently recognized two award-winning digital signage projects during its annual Sign Design Contest held at Sales Expo 2026. Voted on exclusively by sign company professionals attending the event, the contest celebrates creative and effective digital sign designs that help organizations communicate, engage audiences and strengthen their brands.


This year's winners were Amanda Lauridsen of Precise Sign Co. in the Galaxy 49 square feet and smaller category for a project with Osborn School District in Phoenix, Arizona, and James Fuchsel of La Crosse Sign Group in the Galaxy 50 square feet and larger category for a digital sign redesign at Dells Dinner Theater in Wisconsin Dells, Wisconsin.


"Each year, the Sign Design Contest showcases the creativity, expertise and partnership that help sign companies deliver exceptional digital signage solutions," said Jess Bern, Daktronics marketing strategist. "The winning projects demonstrate how thoughtful design and the right digital display technology can help organizations stand out, connect with their audiences and achieve their communication goals."


## About the Winning Signs


### Galaxy 50 Square Feet and Larger Winner: La Crosse Sign Group | Dells Dinner Theater | Wisconsin Dells, Wisconsin


La Crosse Sign Group earned top honors in the large-format category for a digital sign redesign at Dells Dinner Theater. The project replaced an existing vertical-format display with a larger, more dynamic electronic message center designed to attract visitors in the highly competitive Wisconsin Dells entertainment market.


The sign company selected a Daktronics GT6x 10-millimeter display to provide the size, image quality and flexibility the customer needed while remaining within budget. According to the submission, the display helps the theater promote performances more effectively and eliminates the limitations of updating traditional signage in varying weather conditions.


A six-time winner in the annual Sign Design Contest, La Crosse Sign Group was recognized by fellow sign company professionals for a design that combines strong visual impact with practical business value.


### Galaxy 49 Square Feet and Smaller Winner: Precise Sign Co. | Osborn School District | Phoenix, Arizona


Precise Sign Co. received the award in the small-format category for its digital signage project with Osborn School District, where they provided six installations.


The district sought a modern display that would support a broader district rebranding effort while reflecting school pride and creating a welcoming presence within the surrounding neighborhood. The resulting design incorporated vibrant colors and a contemporary appearance while maintaining the scale and budget requirements established by the district.


To meet the customer's communication needs, Precise Sign Co. selected a Daktronics GT6X 8-millimeter display, balancing image quality, viewing distance and budget considerations. The digital sign extends the district's visual identity while providing a flexible platform for school communications.


### About the Sign Design Contest


The Sign Design Contest is a featured activity at Daktronics Sales Expo, where sign company professionals vote to recognize outstanding digital signage projects submitted by their peers. Winning projects are selected based on design excellence, effective use of digital display technology and the ability to meet customer objectives.


### ​​About Daktronics


Daktronics helps its customers to impact their audiences throughout the world with large-format LED video displays, message displays, scoreboards, digital billboards, audio systems and control systems in sport, business and transportation applications. Founded in 1968 as a USA-based manufacturing company, Daktronics has grown into the world leader in audiovisual systems and implementation with offices around the globe.
